items.question: Should I come in or book a video visit?
items.answer: Video works well for colds, mild flu and refills. Come in for ear pain, a high fever in a child or anything that needs a test.

items.question: Do you see children the same day?
items.answer: Yes. Same-day sick visits are open to every age, from newborns up.
